question: The final round of 78th Senior National Football for Santosh Trophy was held in which city?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hyderabad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **78th Senior National Football Championship for Santosh Trophy** final round was conducted in **Hyderabad**, Telangana, showcasing the nation’s top football talent.
 
• The championship is one of the most prestigious football tournaments in India, established in **1941**, and is named after the late Maharaja of Santosh.
 
• In the 78th edition, football teams from various states and Union Territories competed fiercely to win the coveted trophy.
 
• **Hyderabad** was selected due to its modern football facilities and infrastructure, making it an ideal venue for hosting national-level tournaments.
 
• This edition witnessed a massive turnout of football enthusiasts, reflecting the growing popularity of football in India.
